COZY COLOR POP

Emerald Plaid + Black Denim Weekend

A warm, easy fall-to-winter outfit built around black layers, light denim and a vivid emerald tartan scarf. Gold accents keep the casual pieces polished, while the platform mini boots balance the wider jean leg.

WHAT TO BUY FIRST
  1. Green tartan scarf — the signature color and pattern.
  2. Black corduroy puffer vest — establishes the cozy layered texture.
  3. Light-wash wide-leg jeans — getting the silhouette right matters.
  4. Black UGG platforms — visually ground the wide leg.
  5. Black shoulder bag — repeats the black-and-gold finish.
STYLING TIP

Let the scarf be the only bright color. Keep the base white, black and pale denim, then repeat gold in just the hoops, belt buckle and bag hardware. That makes the green look intentional instead of busy.
